# ProjectionDistortionBound

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A quantitative bound on how much random projection can distort the relative ordering or geometry of critical points in a loss landscape. Provides theoretical guarantees for when neuromorphic hardware can use random projections for input encoding without losing optimization fidelity.
